```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

posit_models <- tibble::tribble(
  ~model              , ~creator      , ~description                                                , ~cost , ~speed ,
  "Gemma 4 26B (A4B)" , "Google"      , "Fastest"                                                   , 0.10  , 84.8   ,
  "Claude Haiku 4.5"  , "Anthropic"   , "Fast"                                                      , 0.33  , 80.2   ,
  "Claude Sonnet 4.6" , "Anthropic"   , "Balanced"                                                  , 1.00  , 44.3   ,
  "Claude Sonnet 5"   , "Anthropic"   , "Balanced"                                                  , 1.00  , 75.3   ,
  "Claude Opus 4.6"   , "Anthropic"   , "Smart"                                                     , 1.67  , 38.2   ,
  "Claude Opus 4.8"   , "Anthropic"   , "Smartest"                                                  , 1.67  , 59.0   ,
  "GLM 5.2"           , "Z.ai"        , "Older GLM model. Good at coding, less so at data analysis" , 0.38  , 63.0   ,
  "Kimi K3"           , "Moonshot AI" , "Smart and balanced"                                        , 1.00  , 41.6   ,
  "GLM 5.3 Flash"     , "Z.ai"        , "Smart, fast, and inexpensive"                              , 0.05  , 71.4   ,
  "GLM 5.3"           , "Z.ai"        , "Smart, relatively inexpensive"                             , 0.38  , 70.4
)

posit_models |>
  gt::gt(id = "posit-model-comparison-table") |>
  gt::cols_label(
    model = "Model",
    creator = "Creator",
    description = "Description",
    cost = "Posit cost (relative)",
    speed = "Speed (tokens/second)"
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_number(
    columns = cost,
    decimals = 2,
    drop_trailing_zeros = TRUE,
    pattern = "{x}x"
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = speed, decimals = 1) |>
  gt::sub_missing(columns = c(cost, speed), missing_text = "") |>
  gt::data_color(
    columns = cost,
    palette = c("#fff5ed", "#e77d38"),
    domain = c(0, 1.7)
  ) |>
  gt::data_color(
    columns = speed,
    palette = c("#eef9f7", "#3a9994"),
    domain = c(0, 100)
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "left",
    columns = c(model, creator, description)
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(cost, speed)
  ) |>
  gt::cols_width(
    model ~ gt::pct(22),
    creator ~ gt::pct(13),
    description ~ gt::pct(33),
    cost ~ gt::pct(14),
    speed ~ gt::pct(18)
  ) |>
  gt::tab_options(
    table.width = gt::pct(100),
    table.font.size = gt::px(22),
    column_labels.font.size = gt::px(19),
    column_labels.padding = gt::px(8),
    data_row.padding = gt::px(9),
    source_notes.font.size = gt::px(14),
    source_notes.padding = gt::px(7),
    table_body.hlines.color = "#d9d9d9",
    table.border.top.style = "none",
    table.border.bottom.style = "none"
  ) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note = "Speed: Artificial Analysis measurements, not measured on Posit AI Pass."
  )
```

::: notes
The cost column reports the relative cost shown in the Posit AI Pass model
picker, not each model creator's public API price.

Artificial Analysis measures output speed after generation starts. It does not
include time to the first token. These are Artificial Analysis measurements for
the model configuration shown on each model page, not measurements of the
Posit AI Pass deployments.

The descriptions reproduce the model picker and the Posit post about GLM 5.2
and Kimi K3.

The picker lists GLM 5.3 Flash and GLM 5.3 under More models. GLM 5.3 Flash is
the cheapest model available through Posit AI Pass, half the per-token price of
Gemma 4 26B. GLM 5.3 is Ox Alpha, the anonymous model that was popular on
OpenRouter.

The picker marks Gemma 4 26B, Claude Haiku 4.5, and GLM 5.2 as going away soon.

Model creators:

* Gemma: Google
* Claude: Anthropic
* GLM: Z.ai
* Kimi: Moonshot AI
:::
